metadata.researchStatus: Preliminary listing screen. Listing claims, zoning, flood, wetlands, access, utilities, commercial use and availability require independent verification.

properties.name: Improved Suwannee River Retreat
properties.locationAccuracy: Listing coordinates; parcel and boundaries require GIS verification
properties.zoning: ESA2 reported — permitted uses require county verification
properties.waterfront: Suwannee River frontage with floating dock reported
properties.floodZone: Unknown; river floodplain review is critical
properties.utilities: Electric, well, septic, internet and covered RV pad reported
properties.summary: The river, dock, covered RV pad and existing utilities create an unusually fast path to private use and a compelling guest experience. Floodplain, ESA2 restrictions, commercial entitlement and usable dry acreage decide whether it is a business or simply an excellent retreat.

confirmed: 22.54 acres and a $389,000 asking price were advertised when screened.
The listing reports river frontage, a floating dock, fenced riverfront acreage and a covered RV pad.
Electric, well, septic and internet are reported as connected.
unknowns: How much acreage is outside floodplain and wetlands?
What uses are permitted under ESA2 zoning?
Can commercial lodging or campground use be approved?
Are the dock, septic, well and RV improvements permitted and transferable?
dealKillers: Flood and environmental constraints leave too little usable land.
Commercial transient use is prohibited.
Access or evacuation limitations make guest operations unsafe.
Existing improvements are unpermitted or unsuitable for expansion.
nextActions: Pull the parcel, floodplain, wetlands, zoning and future-land-use layers.
Ask Suwannee County for a written campground and short-term-rental use path.
Verify permits and capacity for the dock, well, septic, power and RV pad.

properties.name: Cypress Preserve at Cherry Lake
properties.locationAccuracy: Approximate Cherry Lake marker pending parcel GIS verification
properties.zoning: Agricultural use reported — county verification required
properties.waterfront: Near Cherry Lake with ponds and water features reported; direct lake frontage unclear
properties.utilities: Electric, city water and permitted driveways reported
properties.summary: Twenty inexpensive acres near Cherry Lake with utilities, permitted access and ponds reported. The larger 78-acre assemblage option gives Joe a rare path to start small and expand, provided commercial use and wastewater are realistic.

confirmed: The current listing advertises 20 acres for $160,000.
Electric, city water, permitted driveways and approximately two cleared acres are reported.
Additional acreage within a roughly 78-acre offering may be available.
unknowns: Does the parcel actually touch Cherry Lake or only sit nearby?
Can campground or cabin use be approved?
How much acreage is usable after ponds, wetlands and stormwater?
What are the terms and boundaries of any expansion acreage?
dealKillers: The lake association is overstated and the site lacks a destination draw.
Commercial transient use cannot be approved.
Wastewater or wetland constraints prevent a viable layout.
nextActions: Verify parcel boundaries, lake relationship, zoning and future land use.
Ask Madison County about campground, cabin and event uses.
Confirm utility locations, driveway permits and expansion-parcel pricing.

properties.name: Jody Morgan Road Recreation Tract
properties.locationAccuracy: Approximate address marker pending parcel GIS verification
properties.waterfront: No direct waterfront confirmed; Steinhatchee and Gulf recreation nearby
properties.moneyToday: NOT YET — LOCATION HAS REAL DRAW
properties.summary: A larger and cheaper verified replacement for the earlier unconfirmed Steinhatchee lead. The fishing and scalloping market supplies the destination, while zoning, flood, utilities and practical RV access remain completely open questions.

confirmed: The listing advertises 25.82 acres for $239,900.
The property is in the Steinhatchee market with established fishing, boating and scalloping demand.
The price leaves substantial capital for phased infrastructure.
unknowns: What zoning and future land use apply?
How much land is dry and buildable?
Are power, well and wastewater economically available?
Can large RVs reach and enter the property safely?
dealKillers: Floodplain or wetlands consume the usable acreage.
Commercial campground use is not approvable.
Road or utility improvements erase the low land price.
nextActions: Identify the parcel and map flood, wetlands, soils and access.
Confirm campground and temporary-RV rules with Taylor County.
Price power, water, wastewater and commercial entrance requirements.

properties.name: US 90 Commercial-Approved Pine Tract
properties.locationAccuracy: Approximate US 90 marker pending parcel GIS verification
properties.zoning: AG-2 reported; county commercial-use approval advertised
properties.waterfront: No frontage; near Suwannee and Withlacoochee rivers and state lands
properties.floodZone: Advertised high and dry; independent verification required
properties.moneyToday: NOT YET — ONE OF THE STRONGEST LEADS
properties.summary: Highway frontage, dual access, nearby rivers and state forest, and advertised county commercial-use approval make this the strongest business-oriented lead in the new batch. The approval document and exact permitted use must be obtained before believing the headline.

confirmed: The listing advertises 20 acres for $282,000.
More than 1,000 feet of US 90 frontage plus Mango Avenue access are reported.
AG-2 zoning, high-and-dry land and county commercial-use approval are advertised.
Twin Rivers State Forest, two rivers and Suwannee River State Park are reported within minutes.
unknowns: What exact use did the county approve and does it run with the land?
Are commercial entrances already permitted?
What utility and wastewater systems are feasible?
How much traffic can the site realistically capture?
dealKillers: The commercial approval does not include the intended use.
FDOT access improvements are cost-prohibitive.
Wastewater limitations prevent a viable site count.
nextActions: Obtain the written county commercial-use approval and parcel records.
Confirm FDOT and Mango Avenue access rights and entrance requirements.
Complete flood, soils, utilities and conceptual site-count screening.

properties.name: Wooded Recreation Tract near Rum Island
properties.locationAccuracy: Approximate address marker pending parcel GIS verification
properties.listingStatus: Active when screened; conflicting duplicate-listing prices require confirmation
properties.waterfront: No direct frontage confirmed; near Rum Island and Santa Fe River recreation
properties.utilities: No onsite utilities reported; electric nearby
properties.moneyToday: NOT YET — CONFIRM THE REAL PRICE FIRST
properties.summary: The springs corridor supplies an exceptional destination story, but the property appears raw and duplicate listings show conflicting prices. It belongs in the queue only after the seller, parcel configuration and actual asking price are confirmed.

confirmed: The listing advertises 20 wooded acres near Rum Island Springs and the Santa Fe River.
Agricultural zoning, no HOA and no deed restrictions are reported.
Ichetucknee, Ginnie, Gilchrist Blue and Poe springs are nearby regional draws.
unknowns: Is the asking price $450,000 for 20 acres or $225,000 for a 10-acre split?
Can commercial lodging or campground use be approved?
What utilities, road upgrades and wastewater systems are required?
How much land is floodplain or environmentally constrained?
dealKillers: The verified purchase price is too high for raw land.
Commercial transient use is prohibited.
Flood, access or wastewater constraints eliminate a viable layout.
nextActions: Call the listing agent and resolve parcel size, split options and actual price.
Verify zoning, floodplain, wetlands and commercial-use path with Columbia County.
Estimate utility extension, road and wastewater costs.

properties.name: Twenty-Acre White Springs Tract
properties.locationAccuracy: Approximate 27th Road marker pending parcel GIS verification
properties.waterfront: No waterfront confirmed; regional river and park access
properties.moneyToday: NOT YET — CHEAP LAND, EXPENSIVE QUESTIONS
properties.summary: Affordable acreage near White Springs, Big Shoals and Spirit of the Suwannee with interstate convenience. It is a clean blank slate, but every dollar saved on acquisition may be consumed by roads, power, water and wastewater.

confirmed: The listing advertises 20.03 acres for $199,000 with a second similar parcel available.
A-1 zoning and no HOA are reported.
White Springs, Big Shoals and Spirit of the Suwannee are advertised as nearby attractions.
unknowns: Can campground or cabin use be approved under A-1?
What is the all-weather commercial access condition?
How far are power and broadband?
What do soils, floodplain and wetlands allow?
dealKillers: Utility and road costs erase the acquisition savings.
Commercial transient use is not approvable.
The site lacks enough direct attraction to sustain occupancy.
nextActions: Verify zoning, future land use, floodplain, wetlands and soils.
Price power, well, septic or commercial wastewater and road work.
Compare demand and revenue potential against Suwannee Sanctuary and Twin Rivers Gateway.

properties.name: Improved Levy County Pasture
properties.locationAccuracy: Approximate SE 35th Street marker pending parcel GIS verification
properties.zoning: Agricultural/farm use reported — exact zoning requires verification
properties.utilities: Well, electric, 50-amp RV service and metal shelter reported
properties.moneyToday: NOT YET — ABOVE BUDGET, BUT LIVE-ON-SITE READY
properties.summary: The price is above target and the listing is pending, but the well, electric, RV hookup, shelter, fencing, pasture and paved access could remove months of startup friction. This is the clearest live-on-site candidate and a useful benchmark for the true cost of raw land.

confirmed: The listing advertises 20.43 acres for $649,900 and currently shows pending.
Well, electric, 50-amp RV service and a three-sided metal structure are reported.
The land is described as fenced and cross-fenced pasture with a private entrance and mature oaks.
unknowns: Will the pending contract close or return to market?
Can RV-destination or commercial lodging use be approved?
Are existing improvements permitted and adequate for immediate occupancy?
How much premium is justified by the installed infrastructure?
dealKillers: The seller will not negotiate near a defensible infrastructure-adjusted value.
Commercial use cannot be approved.
The existing systems are private-use only and require expensive replacement.
nextActions: Monitor listing status and obtain a complete improvement and permit inventory.
Verify zoning, flood, soils and commercial-use path with Levy County.
Compare total move-in and Phase 1 cost against cheaper raw candidates.
